test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2022: Official Paper (Held On: 21 March, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Choose the option that is the correct passive form of the sentence.

We had eaten the cake.

options.text: The cake had been eaten by us.
The cake will be eaten by us.
The cake is eaten by us.
The cake was eaten by us.

solution:
The correct answer is **'Option 1'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **When we convert** a sentence from active to passive voice, the object of the active sentence becomes the subject of the passive sentence.
 
• The **passive form** of **"had eaten" is "had been eaten".**
 
• Thus, the active sentence "We had eaten the cake"** changes to** "The cake had been eaten by us" in the passive voice.

Therefore, the **correct answer **is: '***The cake had been eaten by us.'***

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Let's look at the other options:
 
 
• **"The cake will be eaten by us." **- This is the future simple passive form, not the past perfect (which is the tense of the original sentence).
 
• **"The cake is eaten by us." **- This is the present simple passive form, not the past perfect.
 
• **"The cake was eaten by us."** - This is the past simple passive form, not the past perfect.
